description: Geotechnical Extreme Events Reconnaissance (GEER) Association 2016 Meinong, Taiwan Earthquake Reconnaissance - Microtremor Measurements is a dataset listed in DesignSafe Data Depot (published projects), a research data repository for natural hazards engineering under the section "experimental", published or maintained by Farnyuh Menq, University of Texas at Austin (utexas.edu). The Meinong earthquake registered a magnitude of Mw 6.3 (ML6.4) with a focal depth of 16.7 km by Taiwan Central Weather Bureau (CWB) and 23 km by USGS. The focal mechanism to the main event was characterized as strike-slip with an oblique thrust component. Coverage: as described in the project (site or event named in the description). DesignSafe files it as a "experimental" project. Keywords: H/V, GEER, Microtremor. Published 2020-05-06. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODC-By-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support structural performance, hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-designsafe-data-depot-repository.
